name: warp-agent-mcp
description: MCP server for the Warp freight API. Quote, book, and track LTL, FTL, cargo van, and box-truck shipments from Claude Desktop, Cursor, Claude Code, or any MCP-compatible AI agent.
long_description:
25 tools covering the full freight booking lifecycle:

- **Quote** — instant pricing for cargo van (1-3 pallets), box truck (1-12 pallets), full truckload (53' dry van), and LTL; LTL splits the fast Warp rate from the 30+ carrier market comparison so you see a price in ~1-2s
- **Batch** — price an entire spreadsheet of lanes in one call, then confirm N quoted lanes in one batch book, each rendered as a single card
- **Multi-stop** — quote and book one truck across 3+ stops
- **Book** — book any quote with pickup + delivery addresses; card charged automatically via Stripe; charge auto-refunded if booking fails
- **Track** — real-time shipment status and full event timeline
- **Manage** — list bookings and quotes, lane history, invoices, BOLs and PODs, saved locations and load templates
- **Auth** — in-chat login via `warp_login`; no portal visit required

All tools require a Warp account. Sign up free at wearewarp.com or use the companion `@warpfreight/cli-agent` package which auto-provisions an account and wires this MCP into every detected AI client.
